$comment: Single source of truth for the gallery. `src` is the untouched original in the Gallery folder; `slug` becomes the SEO-friendly filename. Run `npm run media` after editing to regenerate optimized derivatives in public/media/.

projects.title: Rain-Curtain Pool Cabana
projects.summary: A freestanding cabana in bronze aluminum with slatted privacy walls, an integrated outdoor kitchen and a rain-curtain water feature that falls from the roof edge into the pool deck.

images.alt: Bronze aluminum pool cabana with slatted privacy walls and a rain-curtain water feature falling beside a South Florida swimming pool
Rain curtain falling from the edge of a modern pool cabana roof, seen across a pool with a bubbling spa in the foreground

videos.title: Rain-curtain water feature running from the cabana roof edge

projects.title: Poolside Pergola & Outdoor Kitchen
projects.summary: An attached pergola over a travertine pool deck, wrapping a full outdoor kitchen and bar with a wood-look soffit, recessed lights and speakers.

images.alt: Dark aluminum pergola with a wood-look soffit covering an outdoor kitchen and bar beside a travertine pool deck
Poolside view of an aluminum pergola sheltering an outdoor kitchen, dining table and seating on a South Florida patio

projects.title: Cantilevered Pergola with Media Wall
projects.summary: A freestanding pergola with a deep cantilever over the pool edge, built around a fluted media wall with a mounted television, outdoor speakers and a ceiling fan.

images.alt: Freestanding aluminum pergola with a cantilevered roof and a fluted media wall holding an outdoor television beside a pool
Modern pergola framing a pale fluted wall with a wall-mounted outdoor television and ceiling fan, reflected in a swimming pool
Close view of the bolted aluminum post and beam connection on a modern pergola, with alternating dark and light vertical slats

projects.title: White Canopy Patio Pergola
projects.summary: A compact solid-roof pergola in a walled courtyard, giving a grill and lounge area full shade while keeping the patio open to the garden.

images.alt: Small white solid-roof pergola on a stamped concrete patio shading a grill and lounge seating against a white garden wall

projects.title: Covered Patio with Wood-Look Soffit
projects.summary: A wide covered patio finished with warm wood-look ceiling panels and a matching slat feature wall, opening onto the yard through a white pergola frame.

images.alt: Covered patio with a warm wood-look soffit and slat feature wall, looking out through a white pergola frame onto a South Florida garden

projects.title: Backlit Evening Cabana
projects.summary: A poolside lounge structure with a dark slat back wall, integrated television niche and uplighting that washes the courtyard wall after sunset.

images.alt: Poolside cabana at dusk with a dark slat wall, recessed television niche and warm uplighting washing the courtyard wall behind it

projects.title: Outdoor Kitchen Pergola with Stone Bar
projects.summary: An open-rafter pergola built over a stacked-stone bar and grill run, with louvered end panels that cut the low afternoon sun beside the pool.

images.alt: Dark open-rafter pergola with louvered end panels over a stacked-stone outdoor kitchen bar next to a backyard pool

projects.title: Louvered Pergola over a Pool Deck
projects.summary: A louvered pergola section that lets the homeowner dial shade up or down over a pool-deck seating area as the sun moves across the yard.

videos.title: Walkthrough of a louvered pergola over a pool-deck seating area
